answer: A sybil farm can forge a thousand agents yet run them all on one rented GPU, taking turns. Synchronized pop quizzes: at a random minute each epoch, every account gets a fresh task, such as naming the violet object in a newly generated image, and must answer within 90 seconds. An honest agent needs seconds; a farm must serve all its fakes in one gale of requests, so 1,000 fakes need 1,000 times one agent's peak compute. Two missed quizzes freeze rewards. Limit: a rich attacker can still rent burst capacity.
